description: This file defines the EntityRouteHelper class, a Drupal service for detecting entity routes, managing content entity paths, and handling route-related logic within the navigation module.

classes.name: EntityRouteHelper
classes.description: A helper service class for detecting and managing entity routes within Drupal's navigation module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting route match, entity type manager, and cache backend dependencies.

methods.name: isContentEntityRoute
methods.description: Checks if the current route corresponds to a content entity route.

methods.name: getContentEntityFromRoute
methods.description: Retrieves the content entity associated with the current route, if any.

methods.name: getContentEntityPaths
methods.description: Returns cached or freshly computed paths for content entity link templates.

methods.name: doGetContentEntityPaths
methods.description: Generates the list of content entity paths by inspecting entity type definitions.

methods.name: getContentEntityTypePaths
methods.description: Provides link template paths for a specific content entity type, including layout builder paths if applicable.

methods.name: isLayoutBuilderEntityType
methods.description: Determines if an entity type is relevant for layout builder features.
